workflow_metadata.description: Workflow for adding or updating a service/system/feature in an existing system of systems, integrating architecture and development phases with explicit delta tracking.

system_isolation.mandatory_check: ALWAYS verify working directory is /home/ajs7/project/saa/systems/<system_name> before ANY operation
system_isolation.working_directory_rule: cd to systems/<system_name> at the start of EVERY phase and subphase
system_isolation.path_verification: pwd must equal /home/ajs7/project/saa/systems/<system_name> before file operations
cross_contamination_prevention: NEVER reference or modify files in other system directories
All file paths must be relative to current system directory or absolute with verified system_name
Before reading ANY file, verify it contains the current system_name in its path
If you find yourself in wrong system directory, STOP immediately and return to correct directory
system_isolation.context_file_location: ALL context files (current_focus.md, working_memory.json, etc.) MUST be in systems/<system_name>/
system_isolation.sanity_check: If system_name from working_memory.json doesn't match pwd, ERROR and STOP

validation_before_every_operation: CONFIRM: No files from other systems will be modified
refresh_sequence: SAVE: Update progress tracker and working memory
CONFIRM: State system name, phase, subphase, next action
degradation_signals: Asking about system name when it's in working_memory.json
pwd does not match system_name from working_memory.json

entry_conditions.context_refresh: MANDATORY before starting (reload all context, validate working directory, confirm system_name)

phases.name: Change Proposal & Impact Analysis
phases.description: Capture the intent, scope, and initial impact of the new or updated service/system/feature.
actions: Document change proposal (feature, service, or system addition/update)
Identify affected services/systems/interfaces
Initial impact analysis: dependencies, data flows, contracts, deployment, compliance
Update process_log.md with proposal and impact summary

phases.name: Architecture Re-Engineering & Decomposition
phases.description: Apply relevant steps from architecture_workflow.json to decompose, update, and validate the new/changed architecture.
actions: Decompose new/updated service/system using UAF/architecture templates
Update or create service_architecture.json for new/changed services
Deduce/validate interfaces (ICDs) and update contracts
Update system graph (system_of_systems_graph.py) and validate for cycles, orphans, bottlenecks
Update index.json and build_ready_index.json to reflect new/changed services
Context refresh after each major artifact update

phases.name: Delta Highlighting & Approval
phases.description: Summarize all changes (deltas) to architecture, interfaces, and contracts. Obtain approval if required.
actions: Generate delta report: new/modified/removed services, interfaces, contracts, data models, deployment, compliance
Highlight all downstream impacts (integration, test, deployment, compliance)
Update process_log.md with delta summary
Obtain stakeholder approval if required

phases.name: Development Bootstrap & Implementation
phases.description: Apply development workflow steps for new/updated services, using service_development_workflow.json.
actions: Run bootstrap_development_context.py for new/updated services
Initialize dev_progress_tracker.json, dev_working_memory.json, dev_current_focus.md
Scaffold code, implement new/updated logic, update tests, docs, configs
Enforce quality gates and context refresh at each stage
Update dev_process_log.md and dev_context_checkpoint.md after each major step

phases.name: Integration, Validation & Release Preparation
phases.description: Integrate new/updated services, validate end-to-end, and prepare for release.
actions: Update integration tests and scenarios to include new/updated services
Run system graph and architecture validation tools
Validate all contracts, data models, and deployment artifacts
Update documentation and runbooks as needed
Prepare release notes and migration instructions if required

delta_tracking.delta_report: Summarizes all changes to architecture, interfaces, contracts, data models, deployment, and compliance.
delta_tracking.delta_summary.json: Machine-readable summary of all deltas for downstream automation.
delta_tracking.context_refresh: MANDATORY after each delta artifact is created or updated.

trigger_conditions: Artifact category change (e.g., from architecture to dev, or ICD to code)
After each major artifact update (service_architecture.json, ICD, index.json, build_ready_index.json, code scaffold, etc.)
After each development stage for new/updated services
If context drift or token saturation detected
sequence: SAVE: Update progress tracker and working memory
SNAPSHOT: regenerate context_checkpoint.md summarizing current state and deltas
CONFIRM: State system name, phase, subphase, next action

quick_reference.context_refresh: MANDATORY after each major step, delta artifact update, or any refresh trigger
before_every_operation: 4. Confirm: system name, phase, subphase, next action
key_principles: Update progress tracking after each operation
Validate frequently (every 5-7 services or after major deltas)
Request source code when making recommendations
